_readme: Source and provenance for the Trades Recognition Australia (TRA) skills-assessment block on occupation pages (lib/occupations/tra-block.ts). Fee AMOUNTS are not stored here: they live in the registry (lib/skills-assessment/authorities/tra-australia.ts) and which program applies to which occupation lives in lib/skills-assessment/tra-osap.ts. This file holds where each fact comes from, the page numbers, the verification date and the official links, so a change to a fee or a program rule has to be checked against the named document. scripts/test-tra-block.ts compares the registry with the two source PDFs whenever data/knowledge is present (it is gitignored, so CI prints SKIPPED for that part).
